dedupe_keys.name: chuwd h historical hourly urban weather database

description: The University of Oklahoma SURF Lab publishes the CHUWD-H historical hourly urban weather database. Its OSF project covers 1998–2020 through separate annual components for US urban energy modelling. The parent includes a station spreadsheet, urban-area boundaries and a MATLAB gap-filling example; the inspected 2020 component exposes station CSV files with locations in their names. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. Weather series can supply historical forcing and comparisons for building-demand simulations in model-energyplus alongside data-era5-reanalysis. A caveat is that gap-filling and station representativeness must be checked before treating the series as local observations. Precipitation can retain gaps, and annual calendar conventions require attention. The review verified repository structure and a year component, without downloading station observations or executing the example.
